# RAGbase Shield common words (French). Written for RAGbase Shield, Apache-2.0.
# Common French words, with many that are also surnames (Blanc, Petit, Marchand, Fontaine...).
# Uses: a registered surname that is a common word is matched alone only after a title or with the
# first name; a one-word company name that is a common word needs a legal form, "société X" or
# upper case. Matching is case and accent insensitive.
